tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Want to actually learn a language this year? Here's the whole plan, start to finish. || Start with the vision. Something you can picture, like holding a ten minute conversation in Spanish by June. || Then break it into three milestones. Your first five hundred words. Finishing the A1 course. And your first real conversation with a tutor. || [turn] Now take the first milestone and make it daily. Five hundred words is twenty new words a day, for twenty five days. || So today isn't, learn Spanish. Today is twenty flashcards, about fifteen minutes. || Do that, and every day you can see the plan move. Words learned, the milestone filling up, and the vision getting closer. || [land] Big goals don't need more motivation. They need a path that ends with something you can do today. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
